name: io.github.Rand0mThoughts/scamstats
title: Scamstats
description: Scam figures for every country, worked out the same way, with every source. Read only.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Lists the countries Scamstats covers, with the people scammed in a year and the share of adults in each.

tools.name: get_country
tools.description: Gives one country's figures, scam types, money returned and sources, from its two-letter code such as PE.

iso2.description: The two-letter country code, such as PE for Peru.

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description: Compares one measure across up to 20 countries, and names any differences in how the figures were counted, such as different periods.

iso2.description: Two-letter country codes, such as PE, MX and CO.

tools.name: get_world
tools.description: Gives the world estimate: the people scammed in a year, the share of adults and the money lost.

tools.name: get_scam_type
tools.description: Gives one scam type's people and money lost in every country Scamstats covers, from its code such as investment.

code.description: The scam type code, such as investment, romance or shopping.

tools.name: search_sources
tools.description: Searches the catalogue of scam data sources by country, publisher, topic or what is measured. Give at least one of query, area or measure.

query.description: Words to find in the publisher, title, region or measure.

area.description: A two-letter country code, or GLOBAL for sources that cover the world.

tools.name: get_source
tools.description: Gives one catalogue entry in full, with its editions and how Scamstats uses it, from its id.

id.description: The catalogue entry id, as search_sources gives it.
